faq.q: What is a good app store conversion rate for a health app?
faq.a: Health and fitness apps typically show a 4% to 8% impression-to-page-view rate and 25% to 40% page view to install. Medical has the highest iOS install rate of any category at 7.8%, against 1.1% for entertainment.

faq.q: Why do health apps convert so well in the stores?
faq.a: Because people search for them with a specific condition or goal named, and a named need converts. The category's problem sits after the install, where a 25% day-1 median falls to 5% by day 30.

faq.q: Should a health app invest in store optimisation?
faq.a: Rarely as the first move. With page-view-to-install already at 25% to 40%, more installs mostly means more users to lose. Median revenue per install at day 60 is $0.34, so the install is not where the value is.
